narrative.northStar: A night walk through a Japanese hakaba
narrative.overview: Every deleted file has its own family grave. Facts become properties of the grave: pillar height is lifespan, flames are restlessness, tilt and the yūrei are violence, moss is neglect.
keyCharacteristics: Hitodama from pale blue to violet

rules.name: Light has a source
rules.body: Glow only on moon, lanterns, embers and spirit flames.

rules.name: Gold leaf carving
rules.body: Pillar names filled with gold so they stay legible on granite.

dos: Encode facts as properties of the grave.
Keep everything hand-made and in one file.
donts: No western tombstones, crosses, pumpkins or bats.
No glow without a light source.
